figures.caption: Figure 1: One-hop and multi-hop temporal routing within a single mixer layer. Transformer: influence from 𝜏 to 𝑡 follows a single direct edge (one-hop). Mamba: influence from 𝜏 to 𝑡 follows the chain 𝜏 → ⋯ → 𝑡 (multi-hop along a single path). Sessa: influence from 𝜏 to 𝑡 aggregates over many paths with varying hop counts (multi-hop over many paths).
